OSError: IncompleteRead(5848412 bytes read, 276537 more expected)
s3://<bucket>/open3d-support-<run-id>/prepared/manifest.json is not valid JSON; run `npa workbench open3d prepare` against this prefix first
fragment cloud_bin_0 no longer matches the digest recorded at prepare time; the manifest and the stored scan disagree

defect.exposure: Both the manifest read and the three fragment reads; neither retried.
defect.identified_object: 5848412 + 276537 = 6124949 bytes, which is exactly the size of prepared/fragments/cloud_bin_2.pcd. The live failure was a truncated read of that fragment; the stored object was and remains intact.
defect.observed: A live `register` stage failed with IncompleteRead(5848412 bytes read, 276537 more expected) while `multiway` read the same three fragments successfully seconds later.
defect.title: A transient truncated object-store read ended a registration stage that would have succeeded

found_by_real_execution_that_unit_tests_: The first fix covered only the fragment reads. Injecting one fault into the built image showed the manifest read was equally exposed and ended the stage before any registration began; the unit mocks had not distinguished the two.

method.harness_limitation: The harness calls the CLI with standalone_mode=False, so its recorded exit_code is 0 even when the stage fails. The real entrypoint was checked separately and exits 1 on this failure, so this is a harness artifact and not a product exit-code defect. Read stage_completed, not exit_code.
method.kind: fault injection in the built image against the real object store
method.what_is_injected: One transport exception, or one silently halved payload.
method.what_is_real: Real objects, real credentials, real Open3D RANSAC/FPFH + ICP registration. Exactly one read per run is disturbed; every other read is untouched.

what_the_fix_does_and_does_not_buy.availability: This is the whole of the gain. Four distinct transient faults each ended a stage that had already read up to 6 MB of real data. All four now recover.
what_the_fix_does_and_does_not_buy.integrity: NOT a gain, and the earlier framing of this commit was wrong. The prepare-time digest already refused a silently truncated fragment before this change, and the pre-fix run below proves it: cloud_bin_0 delivered at 3181482 of 6362965 bytes was rejected, not registered. The fix reuses that existing guard to decide when a retry is safe.
what_the_fix_does_and_does_not_buy.manifest_caveat: The manifest has no digest recorded ahead of it, so its retry is guarded only by JSON well-formedness and schema validation. That catches a stream that ended early, because truncated JSON does not close, and cannot detect a complete document that is the wrong one. Weaker than the fragment guard.
